reading.text: At an adult creative club, members introduce their projects. Photography supplies pictures, while video editing arranges clips. Graphic design helps a message take visual form. Another table discusses animation, podcasting and blogging. Karim works on coding, his friend on 3D modeling, and another member on music production. Digital art uses electronic tools.
